subject: Avery Systems renewal - saver plan concessions and SLA addendum
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Avery renewal - urgent customer concession request

Marissa / Laura —

Quick summary from this morning's call with Avery (Elena + procurement): they are on the fence to renew. Main asks:
- 40% list discount on the upcoming 12-month renewal (current ARR: $1.2M)
- One-time $50k credit to offset integration costs
- Reset term start to 2028-01-01 with a 12-month committed term (they want the contract aligned to calendar)
- Formal SLA addendum to include 99.9% uptime and a 2-hr incident response commitment for priority incidents for the first 6 months

They signaled that if we can get close to these items they'll commit by Nov 24. Risk: they’ve been evaluating two other vendors and price-sensitive procurement is pushing hard.

What I recommend for ask up the chain: approval for non-standard concession package and authority to sign a modified SOW. I attached a quick cost impact workbook and the latest SOW draft.

Attachments: Avery_SOW_v3.pdf; Cost_Impact_Model.xlsx

Next steps: I can draft a formal concession letter and the SLA addendum if you want to see a version before legal.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Avery renewal - urgent customer concession request

Thanks Ben — good summary.

Background/context: Avery is strategic in financial services; they were an early adopter and have potential upsell paths (+embeddings +live-traffic routing) over the next 18 months. Churn here would be high signal to other accounts.

My recommended concession package to present to Exec (to balance retention and unit economics):
- One-time credit: $25,000 (instead of $50k)
- Term reset to 12 months beginning 2028-01-01 (aligns with their procurement windows)
- Discount: 30% off list for Year 1 only (return to standard pricing Year 2)
- SLA addendum: 99.9% uptime commitment + 4-hr priority response (instead of 2-hr) for first 6 months with an automatic rollback if uptime < 99.5% across quarter

Rationale: mitigates churn risk and reduces our near-term concession exposure. If Exec wants to match their 40%/2-hr ask we should require a revenue protection clause (no refunds if they expand within 12 months) and a short-term support retainer.

Can you share the expected margin/impact with finance? I’ve attached a proposal deck with modeled outcomes. I want Vivek to weigh in on whether this qualifies as an escalation requiring Director sign-off or full Exec approval.

Marissa
VP, North America Renewals
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2027 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Avery renewal - urgent customer concession request

Marissa / team —

I’ve reviewed Ben's ask and Marissa's counter. Approve escalation to Executive with the following requested guardrails:
1) Approve up to 30% Year-1 discount and $25k one-time credit provided Finance signs off on impact to ARR and commission clawbacks.
2) SLA addendum acceptable at 99.9% uptime but push to 4-hr P1 response for first 90 days and revisit after 90 days. We will not commit to a permanent 2-hr P1 without a paid SRE retainer.
3) Term reset ok to calendar year start (2028-01-01) but include a renewal protection clause that prevents retroactive refunds on future expansions and fast-track price re-eval if usage grows >25% in first 6 months.
4) Require Legal to include a limited liability carve-out and Service Credits cap (not to exceed 10% of the renewed ARR for the term).

Please prepare an executive one-pager (<=1 page) with the recommendation, impact $ and churn risk, and proposed contract language snippets. CC Finance (I will loop in CFO) and Legal. We need final decision by Nov 18 to keep the Nov 24 close timeline.

I’ll provisionally approve the 30%/25k package pending Finance sign-off.

Vivek
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@averysys.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Avery renewal - urgent customer concession request

Ben / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick follow. The team reviewed internally and Avery can accept the 30% Year 1 discount and $25k credit, contingent on the SLA language and term reset to 2028-01-01. Procurement asks that the SLA response window be 2 hours for P1 for the initial 6 months (their Security/Ops is insistent).

We can sign quickly if you provide:
- Final SOW and SLA addendum with the agreed items
- DocuSign link for signature by Nov 24

Appreciate you working with us on this.

—Elena
Director, Procurement
Avery Systems
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@averysys.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 17:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Avery renewal - urgent customer concession request

Elena — thank you.

Per Vivek's provisional approval and Finance's sign-off (see attached Cost_Impact_Deck), we will proceed with the following final concessions:
- 30% discount for Year 1 only
- $25,000 one-time credit applied on signature
- Term reset to 2028-01-01 for 12 months
- SLA addendum: 99.9% uptime; P1 2-hr response SLA for first 60 days, then 4-hr response for months 3–6; Service Credit cap 10% of renewed ARR

I have attached the final SOW and the concession letter. DocuSign envelope is ready: https://docusign.redwood.com/envelopes/EV-9845123

Attachments: Avery_SOW_v3.pdf; Concession_Cost_Impact_Deck.pdf; Cost_Impact_Model.xlsx

Please sign via DocuSign by Nov 24 so we can lock the renewal and schedule the onboarding window.

Best,
Marissa
VP, North America Renewals
Redwood Inference
